whoosh-fast-medium.use: A quick, clean swish of air with a defined middle.

whoosh-fast-soft.use: A quick, gentle puff of air with a soft edge and no weight.

whoosh-medium-medium.use: A balanced swish of air: a clear rise, a defined peak and a smooth fade.

whoosh-medium-soft.use: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.

whoosh-slow-medium.use: A slow, full sweep of air with a gentle swell and a long, settled tail.

whoosh-slow-soft.use: A long, soft breath of air drifting past.

swish-medium.use: A quick, clean swish through the air, with a little whistle.

swish-soft.use: A soft, thin swish: something light flicked past.

zip-in-medium.use: A quick zip in: rising to a stop.

zip-in-soft.use: Something small zipping gently into place.

zip-out-medium.use: A quick zip out: off it goes, falling away.

swipe-fast-firm.use: A quick, definite swipe: a fingertip pressed and flicked across glass.

swipe-fast-soft.use: A light, quick flick of a fingertip across a screen.

swipe-medium-firm.use: A clear swipe across glass, with a crisp touch.

swipe-medium-soft.use: A soft fingertip swipe across a screen.

swipe-slow-firm.use: A slow, pressed drag across glass.

swipe-slow-soft.use: A slow, light drag of a fingertip across a screen.

impact-light-firm.use: A light wooden tap: a small object set down on a table.

impact-light-soft.use: A light, muffled landing: something small dropping onto a cushion.

impact-medium-firm.use: A solid knock: a medium-sized object landing on wood.

impact-medium-soft.use: A soft, padded thud: something landing on fabric.

pop-large-in.use: A full, round pop with a little puff of air.

pop-large-out.use: A low, soft pop that sinks away.

pop-medium-bubble.use: A clean bubble plip with a small one after it.

pop-medium-in.use: A round, friendly pop that lifts into place.

pop-medium-out.use: A soft pop that falls away as something disappears.

pop-small-bubble.use: A tiny water-bubble blip, light and quick.

pop-small-in.use: A tiny, bright pop that lifts as it appears.

pop-small-out.use: A tiny, soft pop that drops away.

appear-burst.use: Something bursting apart: a pop, a thump and pieces scattering.

appear-dissolve.use: Something dissolving into fine particles that drift away.

appear-flip-quick.use: A card flipping over quickly, landing with a light tap.

appear-flip-slow.use: A panel turning over slowly, landing softly.

appear-materialise.use: Something materialising: particles gathering in and settling.

appear-poof.use: A poof: something vanishing in a puff of smoke, a few glints as it clears.

click-button-firm.use: A firm, bright button click with a little snap.

click-button-soft.use: A gentle, soft press of a small button.

click-clip-firm.use: A firm metal clip snapping shut with a ring.

click-clip-medium.use: A spring clip snapping shut on paper.

click-clip-soft.use: A small clip closing gently on paper.

click-hover-firm.use: A small, crisp tick: a hover that wants to be noticed.

click-hover-medium.use: A tiny, light tick for a hover or a highlight moving.

click-hover-soft.use: The faintest tick: a cursor gliding over something.

click-latch-firm.use: A firm latch: a sharp, definite click with a metal tick.

click-latch-medium.use: A push button catching: the spring, then a crisp click home.

click-latch-soft.use: A soft push button latching, like a pen clicking.

click-mouse-firm.use: A firm, crisp mouse click with a clear release.

click-mouse-medium.use: A natural mouse click: the press and its release.

click-mouse-soft.use: A quiet mouse click, down and up.

click-rocker-firm.use: A firm rocker switch: a solid, chunky clunk, like a power switch.

click-rocker-medium.use: A rocker switch: it tips over and lands with a chunky clunk.

click-rocker-soft.use: A soft rocker switch: a tip and a gentle clunk.

click-tap-firm.use: A firm, definite tap with a crisp tick.

click-tap-medium.use: A clear tap on a screen, with a faint glassy tick.

click-tap-soft.use: A soft fingertip tap on glass.

click-toggle-firm.use: A firm, definite switch: a crisp tick and snap.

click-toggle-medium.use: A neat toggle: tick, then a clear snap into place.

click-toggle-off-firm.use: A firm switch off: a crisp tick and a low, solid snap.

click-toggle-off-medium.use: A switch flipping off: tick, then a lower, duller snap.

click-toggle-off-soft.use: A soft switch flipping off: a tick falling into a dull snap.

click-toggle-on-firm.use: A firm switch on: a crisp tick and a bright, definite snap.

click-toggle-on-medium.use: A switch flipping on: tick, then a bright snap above it.

click-toggle-on-soft.use: A soft switch flipping on: a light tick rising into a snap.

click-toggle-soft.use: A soft switch flip: a light tick, then a gentle snap.

keyboard-letter-medium.use: A natural keypress: the key going down and coming back up.

keyboard-letter-soft.use: A soft keypress and its quiet release.

keyboard-return-firm.use: A firm, decisive Return: send, submit, done.

keyboard-return-medium.use: A Return key press: a fuller knock with a hint of rattle.

keyboard-return-soft.use: A soft press of the Return key, a little fuller than a letter.

keyboard-space-firm.use: A firm space bar: a deeper knock and a clear release.

keyboard-space-medium.use: A space bar press with a hint of stabiliser rattle.

keyboard-space-soft.use: A soft space bar press, a little lower and wider than a key.

keyboard-typing-quick-short.use: A quick burst of typing: a word or two.

keyboard-typing-steady-short.use: A short burst of steady typing: a word or two.

writing-chalk-draw.use: Chalk on a blackboard, drawing a few long strokes.

writing-chalk-tick.use: Chalk on a blackboard, ticking a box.

writing-eraser.use: A rubber eraser rubbing out pencil on paper.

writing-highlighter.use: A highlighter swept across a line of text.

writing-marker-draw.use: A marker on a whiteboard, drawing a few long strokes.

writing-marker-tick.use: A marker on a whiteboard, ticking a box.

writing-pen-draw.use: A pen on paper, drawing a few long strokes.

writing-pen-tick.use: A pen on paper, ticking a box.

writing-pencil-tick.use: A pencil on paper, ticking a box.

writing-pencil-write.use: A pencil on paper, writing a word or two.

writing-wipe.use: A whiteboard eraser wiping the board clean.

phone-keypad.use: Six keys dialled, each with its keypad tone.

phone-vibrate-hand.use: A phone buzzing once in the hand.

phone-vibrate-table.use: A phone vibrating on a table, twice: a buzzing rattle.

mechanical-latch-light.use: A small latch clicking shut, like a cabinet door.

mechanical-lock-light.use: A small lock turning: pin clicks and a light bolt.

mechanical-ratchet-light.use: A small dial or ratchet turning, quick clicks.

mechanical-shutter-light.use: A compact camera shutter: a quick ka-chik.

mechanical-slider-light.use: A small slider gliding to its stop.

mechanical-switch-light.use: A light switch flicked: a crisp snap.

foley-card-slide.use: A card slid across a table: a smooth little zip.

foley-card-touch.use: A stiff card set down: a short, crisp tack.

foley-fabric-slide.use: A cloth swish, soft and airy.

foley-fabric-touch.use: A soft pat and rustle of fabric.

foley-glass-slide.use: Glass gliding on a surface, faintly singing.

foley-glass-touch.use: A glass clink that rings out.

foley-paper-slide.use: Paper sliding across a desk: a soft, dry hiss.

foley-paper-touch.use: A sheet of paper handled: a quick crinkle and rustle.

foley-plastic-slide.use: Plastic sliding: a bright, light scrape.

foley-wood-slide.use: Wood sliding on wood: a grainy rub.

props-book-close.use: A book closing: a puff of air and a thud of its cover.

props-box-open.use: A cardboard box opening: two flaps scraping and thumping open.

props-page-turn.use: A page turning: lifted at the corner, swung over and falling flat.

props-scissors.use: Scissors sliding and snipping through paper.

props-splash.use: Something dropping into water: a plop, a splash and drops falling back.

props-tape.use: Sticky tape peeled off its roll in a quick, rising rip.

props-zip.use: A zip pulled: its teeth clicking by, faster and faster.

notification-alert-clear.use: A bright double ding: an alert.

notification-alert-soft.use: A warm double note: something needs a look.

notification-error-clear.use: A clear, falling two-note chime: an error, without alarm.

notification-error-soft.use: A soft, falling two-note marimba: something's not right, gently.

notification-failure-deflate.use: Air whistling down, like a balloon letting go: a playful fail.

notification-failure-knock.use: Two wooden knocks, the second lower: nope.

notification-failure-low.use: A single low, soft note: a quiet no.

notification-failure-minor.use: A soft marimba chord falling in a minor key: a gentle letdown.

notification-failure-pluck.use: A muted pluck falling a fourth: a dud.

notification-failure-thud.use: A dull, low bonk: that didn't work.

notification-failure-wobble.use: A kalimba note bending down as it rings: womp.

notification-message-in-clear.use: A bubble and a bright ping: a message arrives.

notification-message-in-soft.use: A little bubble and a warm note: a new message.

notification-message-out-clear.use: A quick airy send with a bright little ping.

notification-message-out-soft.use: A soft puff of air with a small note: sent.

notification-success-bubble.use: A bubble and two bright notes: a playful success.

notification-success-chime.use: Two bells rising a fifth: a clear, bright success.

notification-success-clear.use: A bright, rising three-note chime: success.

notification-success-fanfare.use: A little marimba ta-da: two quick chords, resolving.

notification-success-flourish.use: A fast marimba run up to a high, ringing note: achieved.

notification-success-pluck.use: A plucked string rising a fourth: a warm, simple yes.

notification-success-soft.use: A warm, rising three-note marimba arpeggio: done.

notification-success-sparkle.use: A quick kalimba arpeggio up an octave, with a few glints: delight.

notification-success-warm.use: A soft, rolled marimba chord: quietly done.

tone-ding-high.use: A small bell's clear ding (E, high).

tone-ding-low.use: A small bell's clear ding (G, low).

tone-ding-mid.use: A small bell's clear ding (C, middle).

tone-step-1.use: Step 1 of 5: a soft marimba note (C), each one higher.

tone-step-2.use: Step 2 of 5: a soft marimba note (E), each one higher.

tone-step-3.use: Step 3 of 5: a soft marimba note (G), each one higher.

tone-step-4.use: Step 4 of 5: a soft marimba note (A), each one higher.

tone-step-5.use: Step 5 of 5: a soft marimba note (C), each one higher.

shimmer-medium-bright.use: A shimmer: a bright cloud of glassy glints.

shimmer-medium-soft.use: A shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.

shimmer-medium-sparkle.use: A shimmer: a dense, tinkling sparkle, high and light.

shimmer-short-bright.use: A short shimmer: a bright cloud of glassy glints.

shimmer-short-soft.use: A short shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.

shimmer-short-sparkle.use: A short shimmer: a dense, tinkling sparkle, high and light.

time-timer.use: A timer finishing: a click and a bright ting-ting.

money-card-tap.use: A contactless card tapped on a reader, and its beep.

money-coin-drop.use: A coin dropped on a table: it rings, bounces and rattles flat.

money-coin-stack.use: Coins set down on a stack, one by one: short, dry chinks.

money-coins-pour.use: A handful of coins poured onto a pile: a dense, short clatter.

money-notes.use: Banknotes being counted, flicked through one by one.

money-register.use: A cash register: a key, the bell's ching and the drawer sliding open.

digital-breach.use: A security breach: an urgent two-tone alarm, three times.

digital-corrupt.use: Data corrupting: a slice of data stuttering, crushed and smeared.

digital-decrypt.use: Decrypted: a scramble slowing and resolving into a clean, rising chime.

digital-denied.use: Access denied: two short, low buzzes.

digital-glitch-clear.use: A crisp little glitch, stepping in pitch.

digital-interference.use: Electrical interference: a buzz stuttering on and off with crackle.

digital-power-down.use: A device powering down: a click, then its hum sinking away.

digital-power-up.use: A device powering up: a click, its hum rising, a ping when it's ready.

digital-process-clear.use: Busy processing: a bright, steady run of pips.

digital-process-subtle.use: Quiet processing: a soft run of tiny pips.

digital-scan-clear.use: A clean scan: a defined tone gliding up, pulsing.

digital-scan-subtle.use: A soft scan: a gentle tone gliding up with slow pulses.

digital-scramble.use: Scrambling: rapid random pips, like text decoding.

digital-signal-drop.use: A signal failing: a tone stuttering, sagging and cutting out.

digital-static.use: A burst of TV static: bright snow with a faint buzz in it.

data-bar-grow.use: A quick upward swish that lands on a tick: a bar growing to its value.

data-chart-reveal.use: A soft swell with a few glints: a chart appearing.

data-countup-medium.use: A count-up of about 1.2 seconds: ticks that speed up and settle.

data-countup-short.use: A short count-up: ticks that speed up and settle, about 0.6 seconds.

data-decrease-medium.use: A count-down of about 1.2 seconds: a value easing down.

data-decrease-short.use: A short count-down: ticks that speed up and settle, falling a little, about 0.6 seconds.

data-number-land.use: A woody knock with a small, bright ping: a number landing.

data-progress-short.use: A one-second progress fill: rising air with soft ticks filling in.

data-tick.use: A single soft, woody tick: one step of a number changing.
